item.title: Memory of a Killer - Samurai - Review: The Cost of Survival
item.description: “Samurai” is the episode where Memory of a Killer stops flirting with moral ambiguity and fully plunges into it. The series has always been about compartmentalization, how Angelo has kept his work as a contract killer sealed off from his identity as a father, but this hour makes it painfully clear: the walls are cracking, and Alzheimer’s isn’t even the most dangerous thing coming for him. item.title: The Rookie - The Network - Review: A Return So Welcome, You Wonder Why They Ever Left
item.description: “The Network” is a jam-packed episode that tries to balance personal fractures, systemic corruption, and a high-stakes federal operation and for the most part, it succeeds. Where it stumbles is also where The Rookie keeps stumbling lately: its ongoing insistence that Monica is somehow a trustworthy asset, despite overwhelming evidence to the contrary.
